The '''1979–80 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 44th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. From that season Alpha Ethniki became the professional league. The season began on 30 September 1979 and ended on 25 May 1980 with the play-off matches. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 21st Greek title and their first one in five years.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thebest.gr/article/747421-ki-omos-to-pio-sugklonistiko-protathlima-itan-tou-1979-80-ki-ochi-i-fetini-super-league|title=Κι όμως το πιο συγκλονιστικό πρωτάθλημα ήταν του 1979-'80 κι όχι η φετινή Super League|date=18 April 2024|website=thebest.gr}}</ref>

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
